name: San Ysidro District
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: An AVA in southern Santa Clara County, east of Gilroy, inside the Santa Clara Valley AVA. It is cooler than other parts of the valley, with breezes coming up the Pajaro River.
